title: cotyledon umbilicus-veneris var. deflexa
intro: Cotyledon umbilicus-veneris var. deflexa, commonly known as Venus' pride, is a succulent plant species within the family Crassulaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine, and its health benefits include aiding in digestion, relieving constipation, and lowering blood pressure. The therapeutic actions attributed to Cotyledon umbilicus-veneris var. deflexa include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which are beneficial for wound healing and skin issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
